_source: USCIS, 'Direct Filing Addresses for Form I-821D, Consideration of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals' (https://www.uscis.gov/forms/all-forms/direct-filing-addresses-for-form-i-821d-consideration-of-deferred-action-for-childhood-arrivals), page last updated 09/24/2024, read 2026-10-02. By the state the requestor lives in; the I-821D, the I-765 and the I-765WS go in one package (USCIS 'Filing Tips for DACA', updated 04/30/2025). The U.S. Postal Service goes to the P.O. box; FedEx, UPS and DHL to the street address. Copied as the page gives them, in capitals; the Chicago courier line's dash is written as a comma. American Samoa, the Northern Mariana Islands and APO/FPO addresses are not on the page: the attorney confirms.
